risks.risk: Item identity mismatch (could be a different PS4 game or a different electronic device entirely) because the title/brand/model text is not readable.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front and back of the box showing the exact game title (Homefront: The Revolution), platform (PS4), and publisher/part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown boxed electronic item with identity not confirmed.

risks.risk: Not actually preowned/never opened status may be false; box could be resealed or contents swapped.
risks.proof: Photos showing any tamper seals, sticker codes, and the condition of the box edges/corners plus a photo of the contents (disc/media and inserts) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially used/possibly tampered packaging (worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., pads/inserts) or missing receipt/warranty documentation.
risks.proof: A photo inventory shot of everything included in the box (pads/inserts, manuals, disc/media) and a clear photo of the UK receipt.

risks.risk: Condition/functional issues (if it’s a disc/game, disc/media could be scratched; if it’s a device, ports could be faulty). The report shows only the box.
risks.proof: If it’s a game: a close-up of the disc surface (no deep scratches) and a photo of the case/label. If it’s a device: a power-on video showing ports working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / worst-case non-functional or defective.

proof_requests: Clear front and back box photos with readable title: “Homefront: The Revolution” and PS4 branding/part number.
Photos of any seals/stickers and the box condition (edges/corners) to confirm it hasn’t been opened/resealed.
A photo inventory of all included items (pads/inserts/manuals) laid out.
A clear photo of the UK receipt (showing date/store and item name).
If it’s a disc/game: close-up photo of the disc surface and label; if it’s a device: a short power-on video showing ports working.
response.reason: The witness report does not provide readable identity (title/brand/model) or evidence of contents/condition; without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
